basic_details.post_name: Junior Research Fellow and Senior Project Associate

age_limit.details: Senior Project Associate (SPA): Maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/PwD/PwBD is 5 years. Age relaxation for OBC-NCL is 3 years.

qualification.details: M.E./M.Tech./MS(R) or equivalent in CSE/ECE/EE/Microelectronics/VLSI Design and allied subjects with 60% marks or equivalent. B.E. /B.Tech/M.Sc. in CSE/ECE/EE/Electronics/Microelectronics/VLSI Design/Embedded Systems and allied subjects with 60% marks or equivalent. Qualified in CSIR-UGC, NET, Including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. | Doctoral Degree in Science/Engineering/Technology in CSE/ECE/EE/Electronics/Microelectronics/VLSI Design/Embedded Systems and allied disciplines from a recognized University or equivalent. M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in CSE/ECE/EE/Microelectronics/VLSI Design and allied disciplines. B.E./B.Tech. in CSE/ECE/EE/Electronics/Microelectronics/VLSI Design/Embedded Systems and allied disciplines, from a recognized University or equivalent, with 60% marks or equivalent CGPA and four years' experience in Research & Development in Industrial/Academic Institutions or Science & Technology Organizations and scientific activities and services.

salary_details.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- + 20% HRA per month Senior Project Associate (SPA): Rs. 42,000/- + 20% HRA per month

selection_process: Shortlisting based on merit and need for the project Interview (online/offline platform)
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Jammu to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow and Senior Project Associate positions at IIT Jammu is 05 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for JRF?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position, candidates need an M.E./M.Tech./MS(R) or equivalent in CSE/ECE/EE/Microelectronics/VLSI Design with 60% marks, or a B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc. in relevant fields with 60% marks and qualified in CSIR-UGC NET/GATE.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate (SPA) position is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/PwD/PwBD and OBC-NCL categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How is the selection process conducted for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit and the project's requirements, followed by an interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by IIT Jammu for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the positions of Junior Research Fellow and Senior Project Associate at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of these job positions?
faq.answer: These are project-based research positions at IIT Jammu, offering an excellent opportunity for candidates interested in research and development.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience.

faq.question: Q10. Can students awaiting their final results apply?
faq.answer: Yes, students awaiting their results may also apply, provided they can produce their qualifying degree at the time of appointment.
